text: AN ORGANISATION'S DOCUMENTS SIT UNDER ONE HEADING, A TAB EACH. On the DBIM design's organisation pages, two or more sections that held nothing but a document list — NCSC's Reports and Resources; NCSK's Annual Reports, SOP and Advisory, Acts & Rules, Circulars & Notifications and Rules of Procedure; NSFDC's, DWBDNC's and NISD's two each — are now one "Documents & Downloads" section with a tab for each list, where the first of them stood, as the handoff file's Organisations page draws every organisation. Each list keeps its rows and its "View All", which moves into its tab; the page index lists the one section. A body with a single document list keeps its own heading. Nothing was removed.
